schema:alternativeHeadline:
Four portraits show travelers mounted on pack animals beside a touring car; handwritten labels identify Herbert, Faye, Bob and Mr. Daniels.

Written text (transcribed as written):
Handwritten under upper-left photograph: “8-7-25 HERBERT.”
Handwritten under upper-right photograph: “FAYE”
Handwritten under lower-left photograph: “BOB.”
Handwritten under lower-right photograph: “MR. DANIELS.”
